Ritual Tablet
--------
Item Level: 80
--------
Corrupted
--------
{ Implicit Modifier }
Adds Ritual Altars to a Map
13 uses remaining
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Bountiful" (Tier: 1) }
25(25-35)% increased Gold found in Map
{ Prefix Modifier "Collector's" (Tier: 1) }
10(8-12)% increased Rarity of Items found in Map
{ Suffix Modifier "of Omens" (Tier: 1) }
Ritual Favours in Map have 51(35-70)% increased chance to be Omens
{ Suffix Modifier "of Sacrifice" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters Sacrificed at Ritual Altars in Map grant 29(18-30)% increased Tribute
--------
Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map.
